summary: I wrote src/main.ts. It builds a forest of 8,000 trees and 2,000 rocks. Trunks, canopies and rocks are each one InstancedMesh, so there are three draw calls for the 10,000 objects. Placement uses a seeded mulberry32 generator, so the forest is the same on every load. Canopy, trunk and rock colours vary per instance through instanceColor. There is one shadow-casting directional light plus a hemisphere fill light. The scene has FogExp2 and a ground disc. The camera orbits slowly at radius 92 and height 58, looking at the centre, so the whole forest stays in view. `window.__EVAL_READY__` is set after the first frame renders. `typecheck` passes. I did not run `vite build` or open the page in a browser, so I haven't seen how it renders.
